Finish Coat Application & DFT Checklist 18 checkpoints across 6 sections.During finish coat application and after cure; DFT testing mandatory before handover Download ExcelDownload PDF **18** Checkpoints **6** Sections Daily during application; DFT testing per 100m² QC Engineer, Painting Contractor [IS 5411:2000](https://infralens.in/code/IS-5411-2000) [IS 2395:2007](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2395-Part-1-2000) [IS 101:2005](https://infralens.in/code/IS-101-Part-1-Sec-1-1986) Related [📐IS 5411](https://infralens.in/code/IS-5411) [✏️Paint Coverage Per Litre](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/paint-coverage-per-litre) [📘Paint & Coating Coverage Ra…](https://infralens.in/handbook/paint-coverage) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. MATERIAL VERIFICATION | | A1 | Finish paint approved: Type, color, batch verified against spec; test cert and color sample available
Acceptance: Color approved by client (if required); batch within shelf-life; coverage rate verified | Cl. 303 — Material approval | | | A2 | Paint condition verified: No settling, lumps, or separation; viscosity suitable; ready for use
Acceptance: Paint thin and uniform; no foreign matter; no odor of old paint; properly mixed if two-pack | Cl. 303 — Quality check | | | B. APPLICATION PREPARATION | | B1 | Primer/undercoat complete and dry: Approval received; surface smooth and ready for finish
Acceptance: Primer sign-off available; 24-hour drying confirmed; touch test shows full hardness | Cl. 303 — Prerequisite check | | | B2 | Weather conditions optimal: Ambient 10-35°C, humidity <80%, no rain; dry application conditions
Acceptance: Temperature/humidity logged; forecast clear for 24 hrs; drying conditions confirmed | Cl. 303 — Environmental conditions | | | B3 | Light conditions adequate for visual inspection: Natural daylight or bright artificial light
Acceptance: Work area well-lit; visual defects easily visible; colors can be assessed accurately | Cl. 303 — Inspection readiness | | | C. FINISH COAT APPLICATION | | C1 | Coverage rate verified: Paint coverage rate per label (typically 10-15 m²/liter); quantity calculated
Acceptance: Coverage logged; actual consumption documented; ±10% variance acceptable | Cl. 303 — Material control | | | C2 | Finish coat applied uniformly: Full coverage, no thin spots, uniform color, smooth finish
Acceptance: 100% coverage; color uniform; no color variation >5 degrees; straightedge shows no bare spots | Cl. 303 — Application control | | | C3 | Application technique: Brush marks minimal; roller patterns blended; no drips, sags, or runs
Acceptance: Smooth finish; brush marks <1mm; no drips >2mm; professional finish quality | Cl. 303 — Application quality | | | C4 | Dry Film Thickness (DFT) target: Typically 80-120 microns for emulsion; per product spec
Acceptance: Wet thickness 80-120 microns; DFT measured after drying; target ≥60 microns minimum | Cl. 303 — Thickness specification | | | C5 | Second finish coat (if specified): Applied after 24 hours dry time; orthogonal direction preferred
Acceptance: 2nd coat covers first uniformly; total DFT ≥120 microns for durability | Cl. 303 — Multi-coat application | | Showing 10 of 18 checkpoints ·View all → A.
